features.label: What ORBIT Delivers
features.headline: Everything you need to manage your event in one place
features.subline: A platform crafted for Algerian organizers.
features.f1Body: Scan the barcode and enter. No queues, no paper, no delays. Every entrance operates independently and in real time from any phone.
features.f2Body: Full digital registration form launched in minutes. Attendees automatically receive their QR pass right after signup.
features.f3Body: Send entry passes, confirmations, and reminders directly via WhatsApp. No extra apps needed, no ignored emails.
features.f3MsgDetail: Your event ticket is ready. Click to view your access QR code.
features.f4Body: Track attendee count, active gates, and analytics in real time from any device during the event.

howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.headline: Your event ready in 3 steps
howItWorks.step1Body: Enter details, set up gates and dates, and publish your registration page. Everything ready in under 10 minutes.
howItWorks.step2Body: Attendees register via link and receive their QR pass directly via WhatsApp. Zero manual chasing.
howItWorks.step3Body: On event day, scan QR codes from any smartphone and monitor entries live. Your team is always synced.

whoItsFor.label: Who It's Designed For
whoItsFor.headline: For everyone organizing events in Algeria
whoItsFor.aud1Desc: Professional events from 50 to 2,000 attendees — seamless check-in and accurate data
whoItsFor.aud2Desc: Study days, symposiums, career fairs — organized entry with zero chaos
whoItsFor.aud3Desc: Manage exhibitors, visitors, and badges all within a single unified platform
whoItsFor.aud4Desc: Internal events, product launches, training sessions — a polished professional touch
